name: Pelta-class Command Cruiser
description: The Pelta-class Command Cruiser, also known as the Pelta-class Command Ship, was a variant of the Pelta-class frigate, used as a command ship. The Alliance to Restore the Republic used modified Pelta-class Command Ships during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, a Pelta-class Command Cruiser was escorted by two MC30C Frigates over a gas giant. It was equipped with turbolasers.
